title: Sell the News
briefing: Pebble Games has announced the launch date for its big new game. Excitement is building. Plan your exit before launch day arrives.
objective: Buy the rumor, sell the news: anticipated good news is often priced in by the time it arrives.
debrief: The launch date (day 2) and record preorders (day 8) pulled buyers in early, and Pebble Games climbed into the event. On launch day (day 14) the reviews were solid, but everyone who had bought for the launch started selling, and the price slid for a week. A disciplined player bought early, sold into the launch, and did not chase the launch-day headline.
